ctn-codex-review.title: Codex review + auto-fix findings
ctn-codex-review.description: (1) Spawn codex via multmux against the codex-targeting-normalization worktree to review implementation against projects/active/codex_targeting_normalization/design_codex.md. Severity-tag findings to projects/active/codex_targeting_normalization/impl_review_codex.md. Focus: validation matrix in MobileActionTool matches design (element_index+x/y allowed; text+x/y allowed; element_index+text rejected; bare x/y scroll rejected); coordinateHint propagation through TargetResolver into PointActionExecutorCore runs in-bounds check with half-open Rect.contains and fails out-of-bounds as Ambiguous; TypeExecutor coordinate-fallback skips SetTextOnNodeAt only on resolver miss; ScrollExecutor never uses coordinate fallback; ActionDescriptionFormatter display order matches MobileActionTool execution order. (2) For every blocker/major finding, apply a fix in the worktree. (3) Re-run targeted tests. (4) If a finding cannot be fixed in one pass, record under `## Deferred` with rationale and create a follow-up task. Single-pass.
acceptCriteria: projects/active/codex_targeting_normalization/impl_review_codex.md exists with severity-tagged findings
No blocker-severity findings remain unresolved (fixed in worktree or moved to ## Deferred with rationale + new tracked task)
No major-severity findings remain unresolved (same disposition)
./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests ai.closepaw.tool.* --tests ai.closepaw.agent.ActionTargetTest passes in worktree after fixes
If any findings were deferred, corresponding follow-up tasks exist in projects/tasks.json under parent codex-targeting-normalization

ctn-device-qa.title: Real-device QA + auto-fix findings
ctn-device-qa.description: Hands-on QA on a real Android device via ux-visual-debug skill. Scenarios: (1) in-bounds Codex shape — semantic + xy hint inside bounds → executes via semantic node action, no fallback warning; (2) ambiguity — semantic + xy hint outside bounds → Ambiguous failure, no UI tap dispatched; (3) coordinate fallback — semantic miss + xy hint → falls back, coordinateFallback=true, warning surfaces; (4) type fallback — type with semantic miss + xy hint → tap-to-focus + SetTextOnFocused; (5) scroll guard — scroll with element_index + xy hint, if element does not resolve, fails (never falls back); (6) regression — common single-target click/type/scroll/swipe still work. Record in projects/active/codex_targeting_normalization/device_qa_notes.md. For each fail, fix in worktree and re-verify. Single-pass per scenario.
acceptCriteria: projects/active/codex_targeting_normalization/device_qa_notes.md records all 6 scenarios with final pass/fail and evidence
Every first-pass failure has a fix applied and re-verified passing (or moved to ## Deferred with rationale + new tracked task)
Final: all 6 scenarios pass, OR every failure has a follow-up task in projects/tasks.json under parent codex-targeting-normalization
./gradlew assembleDebug exits 0 in worktree after any fixes
